title: Sale Agreement and Title Document Review
summary: Check each agreement for sale against the booking form, cost sheet and RERA record, and build a title chain from land documents with gaps flagged for your advocate.

seo.title: Sale Agreement and Title Document Review AI | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that checks agreements for sale against booking data and the prescribed format, and builds title chains from deeds and land records for legal review.

designed_for: Head of Legal at a developer

problem.intro: Two kinds of document review slow developers down. Every booked unit needs an agreement for sale that matches the booking form, cost sheet and RERA registration exactly. Every land parcel needs a title chain pieced together from sale deeds, mutation entries, encumbrance certificates and revenue records, often decades old and in Hindi or a regional language.

pain_points.title: Unit data typed into templates
pain_points.detail: Carpet area, unit number, parking, payment plan and possession date are re-keyed into each agreement, and one wrong digit becomes a dispute at possession.

pain_points.title: Drift from the prescribed format
pain_points.detail: State rules prescribe an agreement-for-sale format, and clauses edited for one buyer quietly carry into other agreements.

pain_points.title: Title chains spread across decades
pain_points.detail: Link deeds, inheritance documents, partition deeds and land-use conversion orders sit in different bundles, so a missing link or an unregistered power of attorney is found late.

pain_points.title: Names and survey numbers that do not line up
pain_points.detail: Spelling variations in owners' names, khasra or survey numbers changed after consolidation and area differences between deeds and revenue records are easy to overlook.

solution.overview: We build two linked review flows. For agreements, the system reads each draft, extracts unit, price, payment plan, carpet area, possession date and key clauses, and compares them with the booking form, cost sheet, RERA registration details and your approved clause library. For land, it reads deeds, mutation entries, encumbrance certificates and revenue extracts, including Hindi and regional-language scans, and builds a dated chain of title showing who held which survey number and when. Gaps, mismatches and encumbrances are listed with page references. Your documentation team and advocate review the flags; the system never issues a title opinion.
capabilities: Field-level comparison of agreements for sale with booking forms, cost sheets and RERA project details
Clause comparison against your approved template, highlighting additions, deletions and edited wording
OCR and extraction for sale, gift and partition deeds, mutation entries and encumbrance certificates in English, Hindi and regional languages
Chronological title chain per survey or khasra number with parties, dates, areas and registration details
Flags for missing links, name and area mismatches, live mortgages or charges and pending mutations
Review report with every flag linked to its source page

workflow.title: Upload the document set
workflow.detail: The documentation team uploads an agreement batch with booking data, or the legal team uploads a land bundle for a parcel.

workflow.title: Classify and read
workflow.detail: Each document is classified and read with OCR suited to scanned stamp paper, handwriting and regional scripts.

workflow.title: Extract parties, property and terms
workflow.detail: Parties, survey numbers, areas, consideration, dates, registration numbers and key clauses are extracted with confidence scores.

workflow.title: Compare and build the chain
workflow.detail: Agreements are compared with booking data and the template; land documents are ordered into a title chain per parcel.

workflow.title: Flag gaps and mismatches
workflow.detail: Missing links, mismatched names or areas, encumbrances and clause deviations are listed, and uncertain readings are marked for checking.

workflow.title: Legal review
workflow.detail: The documentation team or advocate reviews each flag against the source page and records a decision.

workflow.title: Issue the review pack
workflow.detail: The review report and corrected data go back to the drafting team or into the title search report prepared by counsel.

inputs: Booking forms, allotment letters and cost sheets
RERA registration details and the approved agreement template
Sale, gift, partition and relinquishment deeds
Mutation entries, revenue record extracts and encumbrance certificates
outputs: Agreement check report with field mismatches and clause deviations
Chronological title chain per survey or khasra number
Gap and encumbrance list with source page references
Extracted table of parties, areas and registration details
human_in_the_loop: The documentation team approves every agreement correction, and the advocate reviews every title flag and writes the title opinion. The system prepares the chain and the flags; it does not judge whether title is clear and marketable.
integrations: Real estate CRM or ERP holding bookings and cost sheets
Document management system or shared drive
Copies of records retrieved from state registration and land record portals
guardrails: No legal opinion or title certification is generated
Every extracted party, area and date links to its source page
Low-confidence readings of handwritten or regional-language text are marked, not guessed
Documents stay in your storage with role-based access for legal staff
Template changes are versioned so comparisons always use the approved clause set
compliance_notes: Agreements are checked against the format prescribed under your state's RERA rules, as configured with your legal team.
Buyer identity documents are handled with masked Aadhaar and retention limits under the DPDP Act 2023.

pilot.scope: One ongoing project: a batch of draft or executed agreements checked against booking data, plus title chains for one or two land parcels your counsel has already reviewed.
deliverables: Field and clause comparison rules agreed with your legal team
Agreement check reports for the pilot batch
Title chain and gap list for the pilot parcels
Comparison with your counsel's existing findings

what_we_measure.how: Flags compared with errors your team had already found or corrected in the pilot batch.
Links and encumbrances in the generated chain compared with your counsel's title search report.
Flags the reviewer marks as not an issue, counted per agreement and per parcel.

what_we_measure.how: Reviewer time with the report versus without it, on a sample.

faqs.q: Can it read old Hindi or regional-language deeds?
faqs.a: It handles typed and clearly scanned Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati and other common scripts, and many handwritten entries in revenue records. Faded or heavily handwritten pages are marked low confidence for a person to read. The pilot reports accuracy separately for these pages.

faqs.q: Does it replace our advocate's title search?
faqs.a: No. It organises documents into a chain and lists gaps and encumbrances so the advocate starts from a structured file. The title opinion and any search at the sub-registrar's office stay with counsel.

faqs.q: How does it know our agreement format?
faqs.a: We load your approved template and the format prescribed under your state's RERA rules, as your legal team confirms them. Comparisons run against that versioned clause set, and you can approve variations per project.

Documents stay in your cloud account or an India region, access is limited to named legal and documentation staff, and identity numbers are masked in logs. We use models that do not train on your data.
